column1: # Known line-geometry gaps that `vostok tool geometry` must not report: lines
# retail compiled out (#ifdef'd code, a disabled debug block) or comments whose
# text cannot be recovered, so no source change of ours can reproduce them.
#   function  mangled name, exactly as in config/match_state.tsv
#   at        our relative line (from the function's first record) the gap sits before
#   lines     retail's line count minus ours at that point: +N retail has N more
#             lines there, -N it has N fewer (ours then skips N lines from `at`)
#   reason    why it cannot be matched; required, and kept short
# Add a row only after laying the source out cannot close the gap.
